segments.name: Healthcare and human service facilities
segments.description: A REIT that invests in and leases healthcare and human service facilities, including hospitals, emergency departments, childcare centers and medical/office buildings, to tenants including UHS subsidiaries.
segments.evidence: Our primary business is investing in and leasing healthcare and human service facilities through direct ownership or through joint ventures, which aggregate into a single reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: The Trust earns rental revenue from tenants, including subsidiaries of Universal Health Services, that lease its healthcare and human service facilities, plus interest income on financing leases with UHS facilities.
